verdict.rationale: Tailscale provides standard IP connectivity between devices so any TCP-based tool including scp/sftp over SSH should work using normal SSH keys, and evidence confirms SSH access to boxes (tailscale-docs-6, tailscale-docs-7, tailscale-comm-1). However, there is no explicit mention of scp/sftp usage, and community reports specifically flag file-transfer performance overhead as a real drawback (tailscale-comm-7), which is directly relevant to this story's file-transfer use case. Missing for 10: explicit scp/sftp documentation or examples, confirmation that key-based auth flows unchanged, and resolution of the noted file-transfer performance complaints.
